title: match flow result
description: The result of a wmp.flow.complete for a flow of type match (wmp-openid4x Section 3.3.2). An orchestrator selects this schema by the flow type it recorded for the flow_id when the flow started, never by members of the result, so a result that omits satisfiable is refused. A closed set: nothing but the four members below can be present, so no claim, disclosure, credential, credential id, vct, format, issuer or free text can ride along. That each satisfiable_query_ids element is an id of the verifier's query is checked by the orchestrator, which holds the query.
